section_header: BODY ELECTRICAL SYSTEM — Theft Deterrent System
title: CONTINUED FROM PREVIOUS PAGE

content.description: Diagnostic flowchart for theft deterrent system inspection, showing decision trees for back door key unlock switch, computer power source, ground connection, and LH/RH key unlock switch circuits

steps.test: INSPECT BACK DOOR KEY UNLOCK SWITCH OPERATION
steps.question: Is there continuity between terminal 1 and body ground with back door key unlock switch turned on?
steps.no_path: Inspect back door key unlock switch.

steps.instruction: Disconnect computer and inspect connector on wire harness side as follows.

steps.question: Is there battery voltage between terminal 5 and body ground?
steps.no_path: Open circuit in wire harness between fuse and terminal 5 of computer.

steps.question: Is there continuity between terminal 10 and body ground?
steps.no_path:
• Open circuit in wire harness between terminal 10 of computer and body ground.
• Body ground faulty.

steps.test: INSPECT LH KEY UNLOCK SWITCH CIRCUIT
steps.question: Is there continuity between terminal 9 and body ground with LH door locked with key?
steps.yes_path: Short circuit in wire harness between terminal 9 of computer and terminal 2 of LH key unlock switch.

steps.test: INSPECT RH KEY UNLOCK SWITCH CIRCUIT
steps.question: Is there continuity between terminal 9 and body ground with RH door locked with key?
steps.yes_path: Short circuit in wire harness between terminal 9 of computer and terminal 2 of RH key unlock switch.
